defects: ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hbm REFPB>=2: the bank refreshed last in a 32-REFpb set could be refreshed again first in the next set < tRFCpb later (90 violations in the idxkey write->read runs)

fix: default REF_LEGACY=0: REFpb at max(due, bank tRC/tRP/tRFCpb) in the first slot clear of committed ACTs (ACT->REFpb >= tRRD_L, REFpb->ACT >= tRREFD) and >= tRREFD after the last REFpb; ACTs dodge the REFpb window; refresh-aware choice skips a bank still in tRFCpb. REF_LEGACY=1 reproduces every old record exactly (legacy_rerun == before). Copies fixed: rtl/dsrom_sys/c8/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hbm_c8.sv, rtl/test/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hbm_trace.sv.
